Fajitas

Our sizzlin' fajitas are served on a cast iron skillet with grilled onions and bell peppers. Fajita fixins: rice, beans, lettuce, shredded cheese, pico de gallo and sour cream, with your choice of soft corn or flour tortillas. Extra fajita fixins $7. Add queso to your skillet $5.

*Consuming raw or undercooked meats, poultry, seafood, shellfish or eggs may increase your risk of food-borne illness, especially if you have certain medical conditions.

Please let your server know if you have any food allergies or intolerances. A 20% gratuity is added to parties of 6 or more. A 2.87% fee is added to all credit card transactions.

Tio's is pleased to offer many options that are gluten free. We do serve items that contain gluten and cannot ensure that cross contamination will never occur. We have a separate fryer and gluten free safety procedures in place, but please eat gluten free items at your own risk.

Tio's takes pride in serving only the freshest seafood, sourced locally and domestically across the United States. Menu items and prices are subject to change and may vary by location.
